items.difficulty_reason: Isomorphism of pro-objects represented by inverse systems of algebras: given a morphism psi inverse to phi, the author uses the pro-morphism normal form (Categories, Example pro-morphism-inverse-systems) to arrange both as diagrams indexed by increasing sequences, and constructs for an object of QC(B) the systems N'_i = N_{n(m(i))} tensor_{B} B_i, proving the canonical quasi-isomorphism from the K-flatness of each N_j. Retained author proof at lines 6461-6504.
